name: @civfix/backend-root
description: civfix backend monorepo: Fastify API + media worker (VPS infra lives in the civfix-infra repo). Depends on @civfix/contract and @civfix/tokens (from the private npm registry) as the single contract source.

pnpm.//overrides-transitive: These entries force patched versions of transitive packages whose direct parent still declares a vulnerable range, each bounded INSIDE the vulnerable package's own major so the fix stays a patch/minor for the requester: find-my-way + fast-uri (fastify/ajv, HTTP/2 DDoS + host-confusion/SSRF); brace-expansion 1/2/5, js-yaml 4, nanoid 3, postcss, source-map-js 1 (eslint, minimatch, glob, vite, tsup DoS + path-traversal advisories; postcss 8.5.28 still declares a vulnerable source-map-js range); vite (vitest's resolution, path traversal + fs.deny bypass); protobufjs 7 (grpc/firebase, proto-parse DoS); deepmerge-ts (html-to-text stack exhaustion); uuid 9/10 (gaxios, dockerode - missing buffer bounds check); @fastify/busboy 3 and @grpc/grpc-js 1 (firebase-admin, multipart and HTTP/2 DoS); nodemailer 10 (mailparser, addressparser ReDoS); and the scoped esbuild entries for tsup, tsx, vite and drizzle-kit's abandoned @esbuild-kit/core-utils (dev-server arbitrary file read). Drop each entry once its parent ships the fixed range itself.
